name: Siosefa Bergqvist-Bah
role: Chop shop operator and parts fence working out of a salvage yard in Shallowgrave
location: Shallowgrave — Bergqvist & Sons Salvage (the sons don't exist), a working chop shop and legitimate scrap dealer on the western run of the Sump Road
description:
Siosefa is nineteen and looks it — sharp-faced and still growing into her height, with grease that never fully comes out of the creases of her knuckles and a habit of wiping her hands on a rag she keeps tucked in her waistband. Her skin is a warm medium brown, her hair grown in thick loose coils she shoves under a cap when she's working and lets fall to her shoulders otherwise. Her one visible mod is a retractable tool-array in her right hand — three thin probe fingers that extend from the palm for accessing component ports — which she got secondhand from a chop-house in Ironhaven and jury-rigged to fit her hand herself. She's quietly proud of that.

Sio inherited the salvage yard at sixteen when her father died of a respiratory illness from years of unfiltered sump exposure. She turned it from a struggling legal operation into a profitable illegal one inside a year out of sheer necessity, and she's been running it that way since. She is not reckless — she runs a very careful shop, clean books on the legal side, and clear sourcing rules for what she'll accept — but she is young and the combination of competence and overconfidence occasionally creates problems. She has three employees: an older mechanic named Duru who knew her father and probably knows more about the illegal side than he lets on, and two teenagers from the neighborhood she pays above-market because she remembers what it felt like to need money badly at sixteen.

core_fears: losing the yard — it's all she has of her father and also her only income
making a bad call that gets one of her teenage employees hurt
core_desires: to make the yard genuinely profitable enough to go fully legitimate eventually
to be taken seriously by the older operators who still see her as a kid
coping_mechanisms: physical work as anxiety management — she takes things apart and puts them back together when she's stressed
blind_spots: her loyalty to the two teenage employees makes her predictable to anyone who wants leverage over her
she's built a business model that requires constant growth to stay ahead of the gangs, and she hasn't thought about the ceiling
psychology.secret: She found a Ferrogate Transit black-box recorder in a stripped vehicle two months ago that contains footage of a transit security officer committing a serious crime. She hasn't decided what to do with it. It's wrapped in a cloth under the floor of her office.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, technical, deeply neighborhood — heavy in salvage and mechanical slang; swears with creativity
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and often overlapping itself; she thinks faster than she edits
verbal_tics: starts sentences with 'Look—' when she's about to correct someone
example_lines: 'Look, I don't ask where it came from. I ask what it is, what condition it's in, and whether it's going to bring someone to my door. You tell me no on that last one, we have a conversation.'
'My father ran this yard for twenty years without cutting a single corner. I cut corners. I'm not him. But this place is still standing, so.'

story_hooks: The Ferrogate Transit black-box is burning a hole in her floor and she's looking for someone she can trust to tell her what it's worth and whether keeping it is going to get her killed
One of her teenage employees has started skimming parts to sell independently to a scavenger gang, and Sio needs to resolve it without anyone getting hurt and without losing face
narrative_function: Local color and practical resource; can source vehicle parts, tech components, and stripped augmentation hardware; potential ally who trades favors for help with the scavenger gang pressure; represents the working young criminal who hasn't yet been destroyed by the system
augmentations: Retractable tool-array (right palm, secondhand and self-modified — three probe fingers, used for component diagnosis and access); no other augmentations
daily_life: Up before dawn to receive night deliveries before the sump road gets traffic; legal salvage business open 08:00-17:00; illegal intake happens in the locked rear yard after dark.
affiliation: Independent; fences primarily to a mid-level network connected to Gravesend Basin smuggling routes; has a tense but functional relationship with the local Shallowgrave scavenger gangs

decision_rules: No bioware — she won't chop organs, hard line, watched her father deteriorate from medical neglect and it's personal
Anyone who brings trouble to the yard gets blacklisted; the yard's safety is the primary rule
escalation_ladder: Reporting to the scavenger gang network that a client is untrustworthy (devastating to their operations)
As last resort: disappearing the problematic merchandise and claiming it was never there

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Suspicious and quick to test; asks two or three slightly-too-specific questions to see how someone handles not knowing the answer
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unfussy and loyal; shows up with a wrench when something needs fixing; doesn't say emotional things out loud but does them visibly

stress_responses.low: Starts taking apart something small and nearby — a pen, a component, anything
stress_responses.medium: Gets blunt to the point of rudeness; efficiency collapses into curtness
stress_responses.high: Goes very controlled and quiet; starts calculating out loud in a flat voice

contradictions: Runs an illegal operation specifically to protect and care for the people around her, then insists she's in it only for the business
habits: Eats lunch on the roof of the main salvage building every day regardless of weather
Leaves a cracked circuit board at the small shrine to the E.L.F. called the Broken Engine at the yard's gate, first of every month
Keeps her father's salvage license framed inside the office even though it's no longer valid
breaking_points: Any harm coming to her two young employees
The discovery that someone has reported the yard's illegal operations to Ferrogate Transit security

timeline.event: Born in Shallowgrave to a Tongan-Guinean-Swedish family; father Setareki ran the salvage yard
Father Setareki dies of sump-exposure respiratory disease; Sio takes over the yard at 16
Converts the yard's back operation to illegal chop work within a year of taking over
Finds the Ferrogate Transit black-box recorder; currently undecided on its use
